series.label: Energy intensity level of primary energy (MJ/$2021 PPP GDP) · annual history
series.commodity: Energy intensity level of primary energy (MJ/$2021 PPP GDP)
limitations: Retained source edition acquired 1 November 2026; publisher coverage and revisions vary by country and year.
Missing or ineligible source cells remain unavailable. No interpolation, carry-forward, zero filling, numerical unit conversion or averaging is performed.
Country, territory and aggregate accounts remain separate. Historical geographies are not reassigned to current successor states.
Compare the exact source definition, physical basis, unit and year. A production index, a percentage, a physical quantity and an accounting estimate answer different questions.

World Bank regional, income and world aggregates are outside country-map records and remain in the original response archive. API dates outside the first and last available numerical country source year are retained in the original response, rather than offered as empty historical frames.
The API observation-status and footnote fields are retained exactly. An empty status is not an assertion that a value is directly measured or free of uncertainty.
series.reporting_period: Publisher annual calendar-year labels; source definitions may specify a different energy or agriculture boundary

source_metadata.name: Energy intensity level of primary energy (MJ/$2021 PPP GDP)
source_metadata.sourceNote: Energy intensity level of primary energy is the ratio between energy supply and gross domestic product measured at purchasing power parity. Energy intensity is an indication of how much energy is used to produce one unit of economic output. Lower ratio indicates that less energy is used to produce one unit of output.

dataset.title: World Bank WDI · energy, electricity and fuel mix · annual country histories
dataset.description: Complete available annual country and territory API cells within each indicator’s numeric reporting-year extent. Original API replies, out-of-extent empty cells and regional aggregates remain downloadable; source estimates and missing cells retain their status.
dataset.license: World Bank dataset terms, with original provider attribution retained
dataset.source_fingerprint_meaning: SHA-256 of canonical per-indicator exact API response and source-metadata checksums plus country/aggregate classification checksum; not an assertion of source measurement certainty.
